scope: A focused, working Fleet Management UI slice from the unchanged reference FleetModule. The original repository's root returns 404 under Jac 0.34.27 and 0.36.1, so its whole app is not used as a working reference.
preflight: With the original FleetModule copied unchanged into a minimal Jac 0.36.1 web-app wrapper, jac build passed. Chromium observed GET / 200, six initial table rows, four Active rows, one Maintenance row, and zero page errors. The shared scripted browser spec also checks Idle and summary counts.
